reponse: There’s no evidence that a 40% renewal discount was approved. The most recent update says a 12% discount was quoted on 140 seats for a two-year term and that 40% is not possible [3]. The stated authority allows 15% on a two-year term, with anything above that requiring further approval, and 40% is explicitly rejected regardless of seat count [2]. FY26 policy also caps discounts at 20%, plus a possible 5% for multi-year terms [4]. The renewal remains pending procurement’s response, with a call scheduled to settle the seat count [3].
